subject: Safeguarded rollout — manager readiness & confidential handover playbook
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Sophie Martinez <sophie@talentpartners.com>
Cc: people-ops@acme.com
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Safeguarded rollout — manager readiness & confidential handover playbook

Team —

We're starting the planning window for the annual performance cadence and I want to lock down a small, safeguarded playbook for managers to handle sensitive handoffs and communications. This thread is to centralize the draft materials and assign owners for the quiet launch and escalation seams. High level asks: 

- Mina: own the manager scripts (in particular the privileged-role script and the private handoff script).
- Marissa: own the ops checklist and HQ approvals tracker.
- Laura: coordinate the legal/HR review and confirm required redactions.
- Vivek: I need an SLO for turnaround on redline decisions and a short escalation pathway.

Attached: safeguarded_rollout_v1.docx (playbook), manager_readiness_scripts_v2.docx (script bank), sensitive_recipient_list.csv (redaction/recipient control). I also pulled an initial scope from Acme (shared to people-ops) — they'll sign the narrower NDA before we begin cross-team comms.

Key constraints / context: 
- A subset (~3%) of this year's population is in sensitive roles; we must treat their reviews with tighter routing and audit.
- External counsel wants the recipient list locked and stored in the secure folder above.
- We will pilot with two teams (Platform Eng + Research) the week of 6/8; roll to org on 6/22 if pilot is clean.

Immediate asks / timeline: 
1) Review the attached playbook and scripts by EOD Mon 5/17 (redlines as comments).
2) Confirm what information must be redacted for pilot participants by Tue 5/18.
3) Marissa to post the pilot runbook + signoff checklist to the shared Drive by Wed 5/20.

If you foresee blockers (legal, storage, or headcount conflicts) call them out here — I prefer explicit risk flags instead of late surprises.

Thanks —
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Director, People Ops (acting)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: safeguarded_rollout_v1.docx (docx), manager_readiness_scripts_v2.docx (docx), sensitive_recipient_list.csv (csv)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Safeguarded rollout — manager readiness & confidential handover playbook

Jordan / team —

Quick scan of the scripts attached. Two quick clarifications: 
1) For privileged-role scripts, do you want managers to state the reason for restricted routing to the employee, or keep the explanation high-level? I lean high-level to reduce information surface.
2) Sensitive_recipient_list.csv shows email aliases for two contractors — do we scrub contractor emails and replace with role placeholders in the shared Drive copy?

I'll put a QA checklist together and attach it by EOD Friday. Sending the first pass as: manager_QA_checklist_v1.docx (will upload to Drive link once ready).

—Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior People Partner
Redwood Inference

Attachment: manager_QA_checklist_v1.docx (will post to Drive)

From: Sophie Martinez <sophie@talentpartners.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 09:34:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Safeguarded rollout — manager readiness & confidential handover playbook

Jordan / all —

Thanks for the share. I reviewed the playbook; a couple of suggested changes (high level):
- Replace explicit contractor emails with role placeholders (good catch, Mina).
- Add a two-step confirmation for redaction decisions: (1) manager makes recommendation, (2) People Ops approves and stamps.
- Provide managers a one-paragraph script for 'limited-disclosure' conversations. Keep it neutral and policy-focused.

I've attached a lightly redlined copy and a DocuSign scope template Acme requested. DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/transactions/details/XYZ-123

If you want, I can run an onboarding session for 6/3 (30 min) to walk managers through the language. Confirm and I'll schedule.

Best,
Sophie Martinez
Principal Consultant, Talent Partners

Attachments: safeguarded_rollout_v1_sophie_redlines.docx, acme_docusign_scope.pdf

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Martinez <sophie@talentpartners.com>, people-ops@acme.com
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Safeguarded rollout — manager readiness & confidential handover playbook

Team — quick summary and owners after the first round of inputs: 

- Mina: finalize manager scripts with the neutral 'limited-disclosure' paragraph; upload manager_readiness_scripts_v3.docx to Drive by Tue 5/19.
- Marissa: publish pilot runbook + signoff checklist to the Drive and flag the two pilot teams by 5/20.
- Laura: confirm the redaction rules and provide the stamped template for People Ops approval by 5/20.
- Vivek: draft a 1-page escalation SLO (response windows and second-level approvers) and share by EOD 5/19.

Sophie will run a 30-minute walkthrough on 6/3 at 10:00 PT if we confirm by 5/21 — please reply if that conflicts.

Risks called out so far: contractor alias handling (Mina), legal turnaround times for stamped redactions (Laura), and manager bandwidth during the pilot (Marissa). If those are resolved, we'll greenlight the pilot for 6/8.

I'll hold a 15-minute sync on Wed 5/20 at 09:00 PT to confirm signoffs (calendar invite to follow).

Thanks everyone — small, focused pilot will reduce surprises.

Jordan
Jordan Blake
Director, People Ops (acting)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none
